findings.title: Lost cancellation receipt allowed a failed hold to resume physics and queued material edits
findings.minimal_repro: Promote one actual dynamic component, prepare another, cancel and remove its real Cancelled receipt; enqueue one ordinary edit, expire only the host observation timestamp, enter Held, then retry cancel.
findings.negative_observation: Rapier steps4->8; y39.0230178833->39.0893707275, vy2.5999999046->5.1999983788; completed1->2/publication19->21; queued World(30,20) Empty->Wood while failed=true.
findings.repair: Failed/Held gates at cancellation, resume, idle dispatch and ordinary send preserve the retained owner until explicit reset/stop.
findings.verification: final-recovery.log: lost_cancel_hold; actual body pose/velocity, native material, ticks and publication remain unchanged; explicit reset disposes32 Wood cells once.

findings.title: Lost completed reset left retry bound to a retired native session
findings.minimal_repro: Remove an actual accepted reset receipt after native session advances, expire host pending timestamp, then retry reset.
findings.negative_observation: Host remained session1 Held while worker became2; retry was StaleTransportIdentity; late real receipt HeldUntilExplicitReset.
findings.repair: Observed worker session is used solely for explicit disposal; unseen material/RIDs are not adopted. Only an exact reset receipt with a strictly newer session installs new main physics.
findings.verification: final-recovery.log: lost_reset_recovery; successful new session and reset_disposed Wood1 exactly once, duplicate original reset receipt nonmutating.

findings.title: Reset discarded admitted input identities without terminal disposition
findings.minimal_repro: Queue three accepted ordinary edits and reset before dispatch. Separately withhold a real applied edit receipt before reset.
findings.negative_observation: Queued action IDs vanished from both pending and result records.
findings.repair: Bounded retired_action_results distinguish queued CancelledByReset/Stop from dispatched OutcomeUnknown with may_have_executed=true; old trace is explicitly incomplete.
findings.verification: final-recovery.log: retirement_dispositions; terminal session/IDs preserved, old on-disk footer incomplete, native disposal accounts only actual effect, duplicate close does not duplicate records.

findings.title: Recovery could enqueue a second reset while the first was queued behind full control replies
findings.minimal_repro: Fill8 actual control replies, queue reset9, expire without draining, retry reset10 while inflight0/pending_control1.
findings.negative_observation: Both admitted for old session1; first moved native to2, second returned StaleTransportIdentity and returned host to Held.
findings.repair: Worker checks both queued and in-flight reset under the same mutex as admission.
findings.verification: final-recovery.log: queued_reset_fence; PreviousResetStillRunning with exactly one queued reset; drain completes original owner change, subsequent explicit disposal succeeds.

findings.title: Replay reported clean success for an explicitly incomplete trace with unknown applied mutation
findings.minimal_repro: Native really applies Wood1; remove action receipt; reset records ActionRetired may_have_executed=true and complete_prefix=false; replay original trace.
findings.repair: Replay preflights uncertainty, incomplete evidence and unresolved operations before creating a replacement native World.

findings.title: Noninitial native sessions prevented otherwise valid standalone replay
findings.minimal_repro: Capture ordinary edit and moving stale/fresh cuts after native reset; launch replay in a fresh process.
findings.negative_observation: Original recorded session2 target refused against fresh process session1. In-place reset additionally retained owner2/gen2/bodygen2/pose15 while fresh registry had owner1/gen1/bodygen1/pose10.
findings.repair: A source-produced fresh-native-registry header permits only current-session namespace aliasing. Other source sessions map to a nonlive sentinel; all owner/cell/incarnation/material/geometry/pose witnesses remain exact. Host.reset inherited-history captures are explicitly observation-only and rejected before native startup; UI close/recreate supplies fresh registry captures.
findings.verification: final-replay-admission/fresh-replay.json:19actions/2ticks/47checks0failures, recorded4->replay1; actual stale session and stale pose refused, valid moving erase accepted. inherited-replay.json: expected preflight refusal with replay_admitted=false.

findings.title: Rejected invalid startup consumed an unrecoverable transport generation
findings.minimal_repro: Host.open(validconfig,MAX_EXACT_SEQUENCE+1) followed by valid generation1 retry; compare actual native fresh-host control.
findings.negative_observation: Rejected InvalidTransportStart left Closed generation9007199254740992; valid retry always FreshTransportGenerationRequired.
findings.repair: Host preflights full generation and bounded copyable configuration before allocation/state mutation and commits generation only after Thread.start succeeds.
findings.verification: final-recovery.log: invalid_start_identity; invalid generation and oversized config leave Closed generation0/no owners; same-host valid retry opens actual exclusive native thread and closes.

remaining_supported_scope_limits: In-place Host.reset captures retain native allocation and bridge pose history; standalone replay explicitly refuses them. UI reset/reconstruction captures are supported fresh registries.
Replay checks named action outcomes and completed semantic order; it does not establish checkpoint inventory/pose equivalence, OS scheduling/receipt timing, or cross-platform pose bit identity.
Ordinary CyberSimulationWorker/Workbench World attachment and mutable GCR integration remain unimplemented; this is a separate real-World/Rapier rehearsal.
Fresh Linux/Windows campaign, final sealed package acceptance, and physical Windows11/NVIDIA gameplay acceptance are separate gates.
